title: Silkroot
summary: Single-use drug that inflicts Silkroot Euphoria.

fields.Use: Consume to apply Silkroot Euphoria to yourself. It imposes disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
fields.Acquisition: Severn in the Guildhall, a crate at Grey Harbour Docks, or Phantaizha at the Elfsong Tavern.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
